records.title: Ordinary extraction and finite algebraic recursion

records.title: Affine ping-pong / Schottky packet
records.claim_level_exceptions: The monolithic packet is rejected because load-bearing tensor-freeze and fixed-modulus claims are false. Narrow valuation lemmas, experiments and handoffs may be salvageable only through a new clean review.
records.remaining_useful_material: Exact counterexamples and first-invalid-inference records; any independently reconstructable L-0114/L-0115-style valuation lemmas; historical experiment/handoff notes.
records.recommended_repository_action: CLOSE AS REJECTED WHILE PRESERVING REFUTATIONS
prerequisites: Create a clean salvage packet containing only claims that receive a fresh claim-level review.
Create an archive/refutation note pointing to the frozen rejected SHA and explicit counterexamples.
Do not reuse the rejected package verdict for salvaged statements.
records.closure_criteria: All salvageable lemmas and refutations live on main or a durable archive path, and the PR receives a closure comment stating that the monolithic theorem packet was rejected without erasing the preserved material.
records.durable_destination_before_closure: archive/rejected/PR-11.md plus any freshly reviewed salvage under research/extracted/pr-11/
records.dependency_or_merge_order: No mathematical dependency should point to PR #11. Salvage is independent and may occur in Wave B.
records.rationale: Keeping the rejected monolith open indefinitely adds ambiguity; closure is appropriate only after its useful negative and narrow positive content is durable.
